overall_reason: The document design is considered (role / actions / impact rows, a dated timeline, a cadence callout, one navy ink on warm paper) and fits a dense one-person CV, but the content reads model-written: an unsourced stat band, borrowed-authority lines ("others called impossible", "a pace the industry called implausible"), a placeholder email, mislabelled sections and links that point at the wrong pages.

findings.evidence: "em@example.com" printed as the contact email beside a real handle (x.com/elonmusk) and a real city (Austin, TX), linked as mailto:em@example.com.
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: real contact email] or remove the field
findings.why: Placeholder contact data on a named person's résumé is fake data presented as real; the one field a reader acts on goes nowhere.

findings.where: links in Public Impact and Open Source sections, tile 2
findings.evidence: dom-794.json hrefs: "@elonmusk" -> https://tesla.com/blog; "Master Plan Part Deux" -> https://youtube.com/ted; "First Principles Thinking in Engineering" -> https://spacex.com. Each link names one thing and opens another.
findings.after: href="https://x.com/elonmusk"; link each talk and post to its own URL, or unlink it: [DATA NEEDED: source URLs]
findings.why: Wrong targets are invented provenance: they look like citations and are not.

findings.where: metric row under the name, tile 0
findings.evidence: Four bare figures with no dates or sources: "30 yrs building hard tech", "6 cos founded / co-founded", "400+ Falcon launches", "7M+ Tesla vehicles". The sweep's stat_band did not fire (print profile). Later lines add more unsourced valuations: "Valued at $350B (2024)", "* $900B", "xAI valued at $50B".
findings.after: Date each figure and keep the source in a footnote ("Falcon 9 launches to [DATA NEEDED: as-of date], source: [DATA NEEDED]"), or drop the band; the experience rows already carry the numbers
findings.why: A résumé stat band of round, unsourced numbers is the slide-deck habit moved into a CV; it duplicates the body and cannot be checked.

findings.where: Experience timeline and xAI impact row, tiles 0-1
findings.evidence: Borrowed-authority lines that fail T-THREE-LINE (not falsifiable, attributed to no one): "Built physical infrastructure others called impossible.", "Colossus in 122 days, a pace the industry called implausible", "Every major OEM announced EV transition within 5 years of Model 3", "The industry assumption that rockets were expendable was gone within 24 months."
findings.after: State the fact and stop: "Colossus: 100K H100 GPUs, 122 days from concept to training."
findings.why: Unattributed 'others said it was impossible' framing is a model's way of adding drama; on a résumé it reads as puffery and undercuts the real figures beside it.

findings.evidence: The section heading promises open-source and indie work; its content is a philosophy line ("First-principles founder across hard tech. Approach: ..."), two company rows (SpaceX $350B, Tesla $900B) and a Falcon 9 landing callout. Its right-hand meta repeats the Experience meta ("1995 - present · Founder-engineer across six hard-tech companies"). "125 followers on GitHub" is the only open-source fact.
findings.after: Cut the section, or rename it to what it holds ("Approach") and drop the repeated company rows
findings.why: A template section kept and refilled with whatever fits shows the document was generated from a fixed skeleton, not from this person's material.

findings.where: row labels ROLE / ACTIONS / IMPACT and Core Skills labels, tiles 0-3
findings.evidence: T-LABEL-TRANSFORM: 12px uppercase tracked navy labels repeat 12 times (ROLE/ACTIONS/IMPACT x4) and the skill labels wrap mid-phrase in caps ("CAPITAL · CRISIS / MGMT", "MANUFACTURING / · SCALE", with the middot starting a line). In sentence case at body weight the labels read as well and stop wrapping.
findings.after: Sentence-case labels, untracked, 'Capital and crisis management'; widen the label column to fit the longest label on one line
findings.why: The caps carry no information the row structure does not; their wrapping is the visible cost.

findings.evidence: Three date styles: "1995 - Present" and "1995 - present" (hyphen, mixed case), "2016.07" for writing and talks, "1992 - 1997" for education.
findings.after: One format with an en dash: "1995–present", "Jul 2016"
findings.why: One fact, one wording: mixed date styles are a seam where generated sections were joined.

strengths: The role / actions / impact row structure per company is a real editorial decision that makes a dense career scannable.
The three-era timeline (1995 Internet era, 2002 Space + autos, 2023 AI era) and the 1999 / 2008 / 2015 'Judgment & Conviction' row are specific and dated.
Restrained palette: warm paper, black serif and one navy ink used for figures and labels; nothing decorative beyond hairlines.
Many body facts are concrete and checkable (Colossus 100K H100s in 122 days, 1,024 electrodes, Falcon 9 landing 22 December 2015).
not_investigated: Factual accuracy of claims about a real person was not verified (no supplied facts); findings flag unsourced framing, not truth.

The capture is a screen render: @page margins (11mm 13mm) do not apply on screen, so the flush-left text is a capture artefact; Charter fell back to Liberation Serif, so type colour differs from the intended render.
